name: Knee-to-Wall Ankle Mobility

instructions.description: Stand facing a wall with one foot close to it.
Keep the heel down and guide the knee toward the wall.
Move only as far as the arch and heel stay controlled.
Return and repeat before changing sides.

performanceMetrics.notes: Record range only when measured consistently; do not force end range.

variations.variationDescription: Knee-to-Wall Ankle Mobility — Supported Mobility Version: Add stable support or cushions to reduce balance or floor-access demands.

commentsNotes: Move the knee forward while keeping the heel down.
